title: Kriptano advertises browser-side AES-256-GCM encryption for one-time secret links
content_md:
Sharing a password, API key or scanned ID? Kriptano advertises encryption in the browser with AES-256-GCM and a one-time link. The post begins "The key stays i" and cuts off there.

Original post: https://kriptano.com/en/
exclude_reason: Product advertisement for a secret-sharing service.
